cohort: Pregnant women aged 20-45 who were diagnosed with tuberculosis during the prenatal period and gave birth during the study period.
finding: Tuberculosis during pregnancy was associated with a significantly higher prevalence of anemia, intrauterine growth restriction, and preterm delivery, with perinatal outcomes varying based on illness location, severity, gestation at diagnosis, and TB complications.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, but not specified as an inclusion criterion.
gest_age: Not specified as an inclusion criterion, but gestation at diagnosis was measured and preterm birth was an outcome.
